items.title: Craft CMS 未认证SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者向element搜索端点注入attribute参数，可读取或篡改数据库，叠加语句还可能命令执行。
items.action_zh: 升级至4.18.9或5.11.2，或临时下线搜索接口
items.repro_note: 未授权请求element搜索端点，篡改attribute参数注入
items.description: Craft CMS 4.0.0 before 4.18.9 and 5.0.0 before 5.11.2 contains an unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability in the element search endpoint because the attribute parameter is concatenated into the query unsanitized and emulated PDO prepares allow stacked statements. Remote attackers can read and write the database, setting the admin flag or overwriting password hashes in the users table to gain administrator access.

items.title: Babelfish TDS堆溢出致RCE
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者向TDS端口发送畸形prelogin包触发堆溢出，可以数据库进程用户身份执行任意系统命令。
items.action_zh: 升级Babelfish/Aurora PostgreSQL至修复版本，限制TDS暴露
items.repro_note: 未认证向TDS端口发送畸形prelogin包，构造长度字段溢出
items.impact_scope: 数据库TDS端口，常暴露内网或公网
items.description: A heap-based buffer overflow in the TDS prelogin parser in the Babelfish for PostgreSQL extension versions 1.0-1.5, 2.1-2.15, 3.1-3.12, 4.0-4.8, 5.1-5.4 and in Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL with Babelfish might allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary OS commands as the database process user via a specially crafted malformed TDS prelogin packet to the TDS port. This record consolidates a related NULL-pointer-dereference finding in the same prelogin parser.

items.title: Trail接口SSRF未授权访问内网
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者向/api/v1/trail/download提交任意url，服务端代发请求并回显，可探测内网与云元数据。
items.action_zh: 升级至0.20.0，未修复前下线该接口并限制出网
items.impact_scope: 公网Web服务，可作内网探测跳板
items.description: Prior to 0.20.0, when PUBLIC_PRIVATE_INSTANCE is not set to true, the unauthenticated POST /api/v1/trail/download handler passes the attacker-controlled JSON url field directly to event.fetch() and returns the fetched response. This allows requests to internal services such as db:8090 and search:7700, cloud metadata addresses, and other network destinations, exposing returned data and permitting internal network reconnaissance or denial of service.

items.title: REX SSM文档命令注入提权root
items.title_zh: REX SSM文档命令注入提权root
items.summary_zh: 持有Rex-RO/RW调用权限的远程用户构造SSM文档参数注入命令，以root在受管实例执行并绕过Cedar策略。
items.action_zh: 升级至2026-07-28后版本，收紧SSM文档调用权限
items.repro_note: 需Rex-RO/RW权限，构造SSM文档参数注入命令
items.impact_scope: 运维执行通道，可横向至受管主机
items.description: OS command injection in the example SSM document provisioning script in Trusted Remote Execution (REX) before 2026-07-28 might allow an authenticated remote user who is permitted to invoke the Rex-RO or Rex-RW SSM document to execute arbitrary commands as root on the managed instance, bypassing Cedar policy enforcement. To remediate this issue, users should delete any Rex-RO and Rex-RW SSM documents created from the example script, in each account and Region where it was run.

items.title: LXD 快照恢复越权获宿主root
items.title_zh: LXD 快照恢复越权获宿主root
items.summary_zh: 受限项目用户可构造恶意实例快照并迁移恢复，跨权限边界在宿主机以root执行任意命令。
items.action_zh: 升级至修复提交c5184be及之后版本，限制快照迁移
items.repro_note: 需受限项目API权限，构造恶意快照后恢复触发
items.impact_scope: 容器/虚机宿主管控面，内网高价值
items.description: As snapshots can be moved from one server to another, a malicious instance+snapshot can be crafted locally, moved to a restricted project and the snapshot restored for arbitrary command execution. In practice, this allows a malicious actor to execute arbitrary commands on the host with root privileges.

items.title: LXD 镜像URL路径穿越写cron
items.summary_zh: 具镜像导入权限的攻击者用穿越路径的image URL向宿主/etc/cron.d写入文件，进而以root执行命令。
items.action_zh: 升级至修复提交c5184be及之后版本，限制镜像导入
items.repro_note: 需镜像导入权限，构造含../的image URL写入cron.d
items.impact_scope: 容器/虚机宿主管控面，内网高价值

items.title: LXD 镜像输入校验缺失致文件读写
items.title_zh: LXD 镜像输入校验缺失致文件读写
items.summary_zh: 具镜像导入权限的攻击者构造恶意镜像绕过路径校验，读写宿主任意文件，可能进一步执行命令。
items.action_zh: 升级至修复提交c5184be及之后版本，限制镜像来源
items.repro_note: 需镜像导入权限，构造恶意镜像触发路径处理缺陷
items.impact_scope: 容器/虚机宿主管控面，内网高价值

items.title: LXD 恶意镜像符号链接写宿主文件
items.title_zh: LXD 恶意镜像符号链接写宿主文件
items.summary_zh: 攻击者构造metadata中rootfs指向/的恶意镜像，解包时以root读写宿主任意文件，可导致命令执行。
items.action_zh: 升级至修复提交c5184be及之后版本，禁止不可信镜像
items.repro_note: 需导入权限，构造metadata.yaml中rootfs指向/的镜像
items.impact_scope: 容器/虚机宿主管控面，内网高价值
items.description: Reported from https://github.com/lxc/incus/security/advisories/GHSA-2q3f-q5pq-g8wv ### Summary A specially crafted image can be used to read or create/write arbitrary files on the host; possibly leading to arbitrary command execution. ``` metadata.yaml rootfs/ rootfs -> / ``` In practice, this allows a malicious actor to access the host's filesystem with root privileges.

items.title: LXD 镜像目录穿越致任意文件篡改
items.title_zh: LXD 镜像目录穿越致任意文件篡改
items.summary_zh: 具镜像导入权限的攻击者利用镜像内目录穿越访问宿主任意目录，篡改文件并可能升级为命令执行。
items.action_zh: 升级至修复提交c5184be及之后版本，校验镜像路径
items.repro_note: 需镜像导入权限，构造含目录穿越路径的镜像
items.impact_scope: 容器/虚机宿主管控面，内网高价值
items.description: Reported from https://github.com/lxc/incus/security/advisories/GHSA-vxp5-584q-c479 ### Summary A specially crafted image can be used to read or create/write arbitrary files on the host; possibly leading to arbitrary command execution. In practice, this allows a malicious actor to access an arbitrary directory and edit arbitrary files in it.

items.title: LXD 镜像覆盖exec-output写文件
items.summary_zh: 攻击者用恶意镜像将exec-output目录替换为符号链接，使exec记录输出落到宿主任意路径，实现文件写入。
items.action_zh: 升级至修复提交124f901及之后版本，限制镜像顶层链接
items.repro_note: 需导入镜像并调用exec时带record-output参数
items.impact_scope: 容器/虚机宿主管控面，内网高价值
items.description: Reported from https://github.com/lxc/incus/security/advisories/GHSA-48q5-w887-33wv ### Summary The `record-output` parameter of the `/instances/$name/exec` endpoint stores the output of the command in the `exec-output` directory of the instance. ### Details When an image is unpacked, top-level symlinks are extracted as is; allowing for `exec-output` to be placed on disk.

items.title: 数据库启用xp_cmdshell致命令执行
items.title_zh: 数据库启用xp_cmdshell致命令执行
items.summary_zh: 安装程序在常规运行中即启用xp_cmdshell，已获sysadmin的数据库用户可直接以服务账户执行系统命令。
items.action_zh: 联系厂商获取修复版；非必要显式禁用xp_cmdshell
items.repro_note: 需sysadmin账号，调用xp_cmdshell执行系统命令
items.impact_scope: 数据库服务器，内网核心资产
items.description: Jumis (formerly Tildes Jumis) creates and uses a Microsoft SQL Server login named ##Tilde_JumisAdmin## whose password is derived deterministically from a single non-secret input - the SQL Server name (@@servername). The on-premise server installation also programmatically enables xp_cmdshell during routine operation, so sysadmin access escalates to operating-system command execution on the database server.
